verdict.rationale: Pigment's own finance page says data is integrated through native connectors and scheduled imports, which covers the scheduled-refresh half of the story only in a single marketing line. Nothing shows per-source last-synced status or a documented post-close refresh schedule. Missing for 10: per-connection last-synced timestamp/status display, documentation of how import schedules are configured (frequency, timing relative to close), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
